newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says killed 32 Kurd rebels in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says killed 32 Kurd rebels in clashes.

text.p: Security forces have killed 32 Kurdish guerrillas in recent fighting in eastern Turkey, security officials said on Tuesday.
A statement from the emergency rule governor's office in Diyarbakir said 18 Kurdish rebels were killed in Mardin province and nine in a clash in the eastern province of Tunceli.
It did not specify when the clashes took place and gave no details of military casualties.

Another five rebels were killed on Tuesday in the Munzur valley of Tunceli province where up to ten thousand troops, backed by air power, have been conducting an operation since late March, security officials told Reuters.
More than 22,000 people have died in the 12-year conflict between security forces and the Kurdistan Workers Party guerrillas, fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
